review_candidates.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
review_candidates.description: MetalBear is remote-first , early-stage, and product-led . We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed. The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack. That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust. mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide , including at Fortune 500 companies . We’re looking for a hands-on engineering leader to lead the Cloud Integrations Team. The Cloud Integrations team owns features that involve automatically managing users’ cloud services (like message brokers, databases, Kubernetes resources and more) to create virtually separate environments with only minimal resource duplication. These are key features that make mirrord uniquely valuable in complex enterprise environments. What You’ll Do Lead the design, development, and maintenance of mirrord’s cloud integration features like queue splitting, DB branching, and more. Stay hands-on and actively contribute to the codebase. Work with Kubernetes, cloud services, DB systems, message brokers, and other tools and platforms. Set the technical direction for the team and maintain high engineering standards. Drive smart, effective use of AI across the team. Help prioritize work, unblock engineers, and drive roadmap execution. Hire and mentor engineers as the team grows. Partner with Product, Solution Engineering and directly with users to drive adoption and expansion. Requirements: At least 1 year of experience leading engineering teams. At least 4 years of professional experience writing production-grade code in Rust (most preferably), C++, or C. Excellent communication skills. Understanding of Kubernetes and cloud-native environments. Strong systems-level thinking and an ability to debug complex, distributed environments. Comfortable working async in a remote-first, startup environment. Nice to Have Experience building developer tools. Experience building Kubernetes operators or other components that interact with the Kubernetes API. Familiarity with backend infrastructure tooling like data stores, message brokers, GitOps tools, etc. Why MetalBear? Work on hard, meaningful problems at the intersection of local development and cloud infrastructure. Be part of a small, high-caliber team where your work directly impacts thousands of developers and some of the world’s biggest companies. Work also on an open-source product used and loved by developers. Remote-first, async-friendly, and low on meetings. Competitive salary, stock options, and a culture that respects your time.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 【工作内容】 - 深入理解制造企业生产、质量、供应链等核心业务流程，基于实际业务痛点识别并挖掘可落地的AI应用场景，如报表自动化生成、异常检测与预警、预测性维护、数据质量治理等，推动AI技术在工厂端的规模化应用； - 负责从需求分析到方案设计的全流程工作，结合MES、WMS、QMS等系统数据，开展数据建模与数据报表构建，实现关键业务指标的可视化呈现与智能分析，提升管理决策效率； - 基于Copilot、大模型及其他AI工具，主导AI解决方案的设计与实施，包括AI工具集成（如ChatGPT、Azure AI等）、自动化脚本开发（Python/Power Automate/VBA）、流程优化与系统间数据打通，确保项目从PoC验证到正式上线的顺利推进； - 主导跨部门协作，协调生产、质量、工程及IT团队资源，推动AI项目落地执行，同时对接外部AI或软件供应商，完成技术选型、接口对接与效果评估，保障项目高质量交付； - 为业务部门提供持续的技术支持，指导其使用AI工具进行日常办公、数据分析与流程优化，建立标准化的AI应用规范与操作手册，提升组织整体AI应用能力。 【任职要求】 - 具备5年及以上制造业或工业领域相关工作经验，熟悉生产流程、质量管理与供应链运作逻辑，具备将复杂业务需求转化为可落地AI解决方案的能力； - 精通数据分析与数据建模方法，熟练掌握SQL、Excel、Power BI等工具，能够独立完成数据报表设计、数据清洗与多维度分析任务； - 熟悉AI核心技术原理，如Prompt工程、知识库构建、大模型调用机制等，具备将AI能力应用于实际业务场景的经验，能有效利用Copilot、ChatGPT等工具实现自动化与智能化升级； - 具备基础编程与自动化开发能力，熟练使用Python、Power Automate或VBA等工具，能够实现数据处理、流程优化与系统集成； - 具有良好的沟通协调能力与项目推动力，能够在多部门协作环境中高效推进项目进展，具备较强的问题分析与解决能力； - 学历要求为大专及以上，年龄不限，对AI新技术保持高度敏感，具备持续学习能力与创新意识。

review_candidates.title: Sr. Site Reliability Engineer
review_candidates.description: About AuthZed We are the creators and maintainers of SpiceDB and the authorization infrastructure that companies around the world depend on to keep their engineering teams focused on what matters most - their own product. We are a Series A company, fixing broken access control with products that eliminate complex permission management while delivering enterprise-scale performance and consistent access control. AuthZed is a fully remote company with employees across the US, Canada, and Europe. We’re a hardworking and close-knit group with a software-driven culture (yep, even our GTM team understands and loves this technology)! We bring integrity to all our interactions, fostering confidence in decision making - trusting and respecting each voice on our team, every day. Company Values Agency: Everyone should have the capability, freedom, and confidence to bring about changes to our business and product. Organizational processes exist to clearly define our goals, but not restrict how progress is made. Collaboration: Success is defined in various dimensions and no single person can be an expert in all of them. Without valuing the opinions of others, finding compromises, and sharing mutual trust and respect, you cannot arrive at the best possible solution. Open-mindedness: Without asking questions, testing assumptions, and questioning our pre-existing biases we risk operating within an echo-chamber. We celebrate the representation of diverse perspectives and backgrounds as a catalyst for creating an inclusive work environment that everyone can appreciate. About The Role As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of our systems. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable infrastructure solutions to support our growing customer base. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment and contribute to the success of a company bringing a Google-inspired authorization system to companies around the globe. What You’ll Own Design, implement, and maintain highly available and scalable infrastructure solutions for our projects, products, and customers. Monitor and analyze system performance, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and issues to ensure optimal performance and reliability. Automate infrastructure deployment and configuration management processes. Continuously improve system reliability, security, and efficiency through proactive monitoring, capacity planning, and performance tuning. Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure and application issues in production and test environments. Collaborate with software engineering teams to design and implement systems that are resilient, scalable, and secure. Participate in on-call rotation and respond to production incidents in a timely manner. Document system configurations, troubleshooting procedures, and operational guidelines. What You Bring Proven experience as a Site Reliability Engineer or in a similar role. Strong understanding of networking, operating systems, and cloud infrastructure. Experience with Site Reliability Engineering, System Design, and Distributed Computing. Experience in various programming languages — we currently have SDKs for NodeJS, Java, Python, Ruby, and Go. Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform and Pulumi. Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack). Experience with lower-level implementation details of relational databases (bonus if you have have experience with distributed SQL databased like Google Cloud Spanner or CockroachDB). Experience working with Git and GitHub. Experience with continuous integration and deployment systems. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Extra Shine Experience with Authorization systems. Life At AuthZed Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in a rapidly growing sector. A supported environment where your ideas lead to real impact. Competitive salary based on experience. Stock options at an early-stage startup. Comprehensive benefits including healthcare (US-based) and other insurance. A full remote and flexible schedule to accommodate different timezones Twice-yearly travel for team offsites focused on team bonding, collaboration, and having fun!
